verdict.rationale: Spline documents a runtime Code API, a Real-time API and webhooks, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI or equivalent), and probes of the usual OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt index and MCP server are separate capabilities and do not count as an API spec. A web design tool with APIs could plausibly publish such a spec, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
